fields.title: The R30-similar article cannot use the specified B tooling unchanged
fields.evidence: D requires a 6m cap; B specifies a 5.4m mould and a 5m tank. The 6m cap has 1.4505436 times the area and about 498 kg of matching aluminium faces, versus 331.852 kg for B. The owner's 15m full-R30 statement corresponds to a 5m R10 cap; its selected 6m similar cap corresponds to 18m.
fields.proposed_fix: Size and price compatible mould, seal ring and tank, or change the article and recompute the boundary effect. Keep D's current price explicitly incomplete.

claim: The R30-similar article cannot use the specified B tooling unchanged
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
